top_issues: WETH sub-line reads '≈ $27,99' (comma decimal) while every other number on the same screen uses a dot ('195.00', '$222.99') — the eye reads it as 27,990 or a date.
'Show 1 empty' link under BALANCES is unexplained; a first-time user cannot know what is hidden or why it matters.
The 'Two colours, one rule' card is 3 lines of prose sitting directly on the primary path between the balance and the Pay button; it competes with 'Spendable now' for the same attention slot.

On-chain $0.00 / Reserve $40.00 / Secured $60.00 / Promised $122.99 legend is colour-dot + text, but the stacked bar above it is the only place the four segments are shown proportionally — at 40/60/123 the violet half dominates and makes $222.99 look riskier than it is.
fixes: Force one decimal rule app-wide: dot for decimals, thin space or comma only as thousands separator; add a lint test that rejects `[0-9],[0-9]{2}\b` in money strings.
Rename 'Show 1 empty' to 'Show 1 empty lane (USDT)' or hide it until a lane has a balance.
Collapse the two-colours explainer to a one-line tooltip on the legend after first dismissal; keep 'Got it' as a dismiss that persists.
Give the stacked bar a 1px divider and a right-hand caption 'of $222.99 total' so segment width is not read as risk.

top_issues: 'To' accepts a raw 64-character entity id (0x92c2d7c32d7837f7a94aa36be58d7198a1f998a6ab1b0609737326729cb2cbf0) with no contacts/address-book affordance anywhere in the set — Rosa cannot send $50 to her grandson without pasting hex.
ROUTE panel says 'forwards atomically · fee 0.0000025 of 0.000050 total' in 12px grey; the fee is simultaneously shown as 'under 0.01 USDC' below. Two different fee representations for one payment.
The full 64-char hash under 'To' is never truncated (everywhere else hashes are truncated to 0x…bfb0), so it visually overflows its card padding.
There is no recipient-verification line (name, last-used, checksum confirmation) before a five-figure send.
fixes: Add a contacts picker on the 'To' field (avatar + name, hex as secondary), with 'paste address' as the fallback path.
Show one fee only: fiat-normalised 'Fee: under 0.01 USDC (~$0.01)' with the raw bps figure behind a disclosure triangle.
Truncate the 'To' hash to 0x…bfb0 with a copy button, matching ROUTE and receipt conventions.
Add a 'To: <resolved name>' confirmation chip inside the Pay CTA when the recipient is unknown: 'Pay 25.00 USDC to new counterparty H2'.

top_issues: 'Settled 05:23:15 · in 8 s' in green directly contradicts the pay screen's 'Arrives: Instantly' and 'Delivery: Instant' — the user cannot tell whether 8 seconds is normal or a delay.
'Print / PDF' as a button label is ambiguous: one action or two? Same label appears in Sovereignty.
The proof hash 0x03213ba4…1399 is shown but there is no way to verify it from the receipt itself (no explorer link, no 'verify against counterparty signature').
fixes: Replace 'in 8 s' with a neutral 'settled in 8 s (target <1 s)' or drop the duration entirely; if kept, make it grey, not success-green.
Rename to 'Download PDF' and merge with 'Download' (which currently has no stated format).
Add 'Copy proof' and a one-line 'Signed by both sides · frame #80' badge to make the bilateral signature claim inspectable.

top_issues: '45.50 capacity via H1' sits in the same row as the amount field with no explanation of what happens if the payer sends more than 45.50 — Priya at a counter will not know whether an over-capacity payment fails or queues.
The QR is the only machine-readable artefact; the entity id is truncated (0x0aa666afc…c78e46) and cannot be copied in full from this screen.

'Prepare incoming account / H1 · Testnet' is a dropdown that changes the QR's meaning, but nothing on the QR or the link indicates which account was chosen — two requests with different accounts look identical.
No 'share as image / wallet connect' path beyond 'Other ways to share', which is collapsed.
fixes: Add an inline rule under capacity: 'Payments above 45.50 will be declined by the hub, not lost' with an 'Ask H1 for more' action.
Put a full-length copyable entity id with a copy icon directly under the QR.
Stamp the chosen account under the QR ('requesting 25.00 USDC via H1 · Testnet') so a photographed code is self-describing.
Add a 'Show as large code' mode for counter use (Priya).

top_issues: There is no Market/Limit control. The only way to place a limit order is the sentence 'Type your own amount to set a limit; the order then rests on your account until H1 fills it' — Wei's core task is buried in grey body copy.
'Hub fee 1 bps · up to 0.0000 WETH' displays a value rounded to zero; the user is told a fee exists and simultaneously that it is nothing.
'Limit price 2,500.5000 USDC per WETH' mixes comma-decimal notation with 4dp; the book ladder next to it uses dots (2,505.0000 vs 2,503.7500 — inconsistent thousands grouping).

The 'Prepare to receive' card (collateral slider, Extend credit limit, 10% buffer, permanent limit grant) is inserted between the quote and the CTA, so a simple USDC→WETH swap requires understanding bilateral credit policy first.

Disabled CTA is explained only by a small red line 'Prepare incoming capacity before swapping' — red is defined in Settings as reserved for disputes, so the warning colour contradicts the design system.
The main column is ~1300px tall; the right column ends at ~1100px leaving a large dead area — no responsive reflow.
fixes: Add a two-state segmented control 'Market / Limit' above Limit price; in Limit mode show the price input as editable and label the CTA 'Place limit order'.
Show fees with meaningful precision and a fiat equivalent: 'Hub fee 1 bps · 0.000004 WETH (~$0.01)'.
Normalise all price strings to one convention (dot decimal, fixed 4dp, thin-space thousands).
Move 'Prepare to receive' behind a collapsed 'Incoming capacity needed' step that only expands when capacity is actually short, and give the CTA a reason chip instead of red prose.
Use the reserved warning colour (amber) for preconditions; keep red exclusively for dispute states.

top_issues: LEGS says 'H3 pays 0.01 WETH into your account there' while 'You receive' says 0.007998 and 'Lot rounding 0.001001 USDC stays with you' — three numbers for one amount, none reconciled.
The tooltip 'Account opening requested with zero credit. Prepare incoming capacity after confirmation.' overlaps the collateral slider and the '0% collateral' label, making both unreadable.
No arrival estimate and no total cost line for a two-chain route — Aisha's task ('know the fee and when it lands') cannot be completed: H1 fee, H3 fee, on-chain gas for both legs and ETA are absent.

The route is Testnet→H1→Tron but the 'Your other account / Main Tron · Tron' selector and 'Hub there / H3' are visually equal-weight to the primary fields, so it is unclear which leg the user is configuring.
Leg status dots are all empty grey even though the order has not been submitted — no distinction between 'pending', 'not started' and 'failed'.
fixes: Reconcile amounts: show the locked leg amount and the delivered leg amount as the same number, or label the difference explicitly ('0.01 quoted − 0.002002 lot rounding = 0.007998 delivered').
Render tooltips in a fixed panel under the slider, never overlapping controls; add a max-width and offset test.
Add a summary strip: 'Total cost 0.0003 WETH (H1 1 bps + H3 1 bps + gas) · lands in ~4 s · atomic: both legs or neither'.
Give each leg its own card with its own hub selector and its own ETA, ordered top-to-bottom as the money moves.
Use three explicit leg states (queued / locked / released) with text, not just dot colour.

top_issues: 'Collateral you posted $60.00' and 'Their debt covered by collateral $60.00' are the same $60 described from two opposite sides — Ingrid cannot tell who posted it, which is the single most important exposure fact on the screen.
'Collateral 60,00' inside the USDC lane uses a comma decimal while '115.50' two rows above uses a dot.

'Their credit line to you 0.00' vs 'Your credit line to them 115.50' is correct protocol-wise but the lane header says 'they owe you +130.00', so the reader must invert the perspective twice per lane.
'send up to 130.00 / receive up to 45.50' are the same numbers as the home card but with no unit; a hub could owe in a different lane.
'If you dispute, they answer within 1 d' is the only dispute-cost signal; there is no estimate of what a dispute would actually return (60.00 secured vs 97.99 promised).
fixes: Relabel the right panel with explicit owners: 'Collateral locked by you: $60.00' / 'Collateral locked by H1: $0.00' / 'H1 debt covered by collateral: $60.00'.
Normalise 60,00 → 60.00 and add the lane unit ('60.00 USDC').
Rename the two credit lines to 'H1 may owe you up to' and 'You may owe H1 up to' — direction in words, not in left/right grammar.
Add a dispute outcome line: 'On dispute today you would enforce $60.00; $37.99 is unsecured claim.'

top_issues: The modal body text is dark grey on a near-black scrim at roughly 2:1 contrast — the three numbered rules are effectively unreadable, on the one irreversible action in the product.

The modal is not centred over a dimmed page: the background account card's '+130.00' and 'receive up to 45.50' bleed through and collide with the modal's own text, so two numbers overlap mid-sentence.
'Dispute this account…' is a dark-red button on a dark surface with no confirmation step, no checkbox, and no stated consequence summary (freeze, 1 d window, chain cost).
The Manage tab strip behind it ('Collateral | Credit | Add token | Dispute…') is clipped by the modal edge, so the alternate entry point is half-hidden.
No evidence preview: the user is not shown which signed frame will go on-chain before they commit.
fixes: Raise modal body text to ≥7:1 (white #E8 on #14161A) and add a full-page scrim at 70% with no background bleed.
Centre a fixed-width modal, max 560px, with the underlying page fully occluded.
Show the exact artefact: 'Submitting frame #15, hash 0x…, your signature + H1's signature' with a 'Preview evidence' link.
Require a typed confirmation or a checkbox 'I understand this freezes the account for 1 d and cannot be undone' before enabling the button.
Use a high-contrast destructive button (#C43B3B on white text), not dark red on dark.

top_issues: Header says 'Today · in $140.00 · out $70.00 · 5 movements' while the list shows 7 rows and the top-right says '7 movements' — the same screen states two different counts.
Two identical 'Sent −25.00 USDC to H2 via H1 05:22/05:23' and two 'Received +40.00 USDC 05:22' rows with no distinguishing id — Elena cannot tell a duplicate render from a genuine double payment.
'Export CSV' is a bare text link with no date range, no account filter and no proof bundle; an audit statement cannot actually be produced from it.
Rows show status ('settled', 'open', 'created') but not the bilateral-signature fact that the product promises; the 'signed by both sides' confirmation only appears after selecting a row.
Filter chips (All/Payments/Swaps/Settlement/Accounts) do not include a counterparty filter, so per-hub reconciliation requires manual scanning.
fixes: Derive the header totals from the same query as the list and render one count; add a test asserting header count == row count.
Give every row a frame number and short proof suffix in the list ('#80 · 0x0321…1399') so identical-looking rows are distinguishable.
Replace 'Export CSV' with an export dialog: date range, accounts, include proof hashes, include evidence bundle.
Add a small two-checkmark glyph + tooltip 'co-signed by both parties' on settled rows.
Add a 'With H1' counterparty filter chip.

top_issues: The detail panel floats top-right with ~500px of empty canvas below it on a 1080p viewport — the most information-dense object on the page owns a quarter of the layout.

This frame shows 'Frame #74 · 05:11:57' for a 'Sent −25.00' row whose sibling frame shows '#80 · 05:23:15' for the same event shape, and list timestamps here (05:11:38/05:11:42/05:11:50) differ from 07-activity's (05:22/05:23) for the same history — the corpus is internally inconsistent, which is exactly what an auditor notices.
'2 committed entries' is the key bilateral proof claim but is not expandable — no way to see the two frames or both signatures.
Selected row is indicated only by a faint background tint; no left accent or border, so on a dense list the selection is easy to lose.
'From your runtime's committed frames' uses a green dot that looks like a status, not a source attribution.
fixes: Make the detail panel full-height with a sticky header, or move it into a bottom drawer spanning the content width.
Add an expander on '2 committed entries' listing frame ids, both signers and both hash suffixes.
Give the selected row a 2px accent left border plus background tint.
Regenerate the whole screenshot set from one WAL so timestamps and frame numbers agree across screens.

top_issues: 'AT THIS SCALE' card: the $10,000 and $100,000 bars render past the card's right padding and clip the '10,000 px' / '100,000 px' labels — the demo of the bar-scale feature is broken by the bar scale.
'Reveal recovery phrase' is a plain button, same visual weight as 'Lock', with no visible confirmation, no warning that it exposes the seed, and no screen-lock requirement shown.
'Forget vault' is destructive and rendered at the same size as 'Lock'; only its red text distinguishes it.
The three HOME toggles (On-chain wallet / Reserve / Accounts) can each be switched off with no stated consequence — turning off 'Accounts' presumably hides the entire credit UI, but nothing says so.
'presets · yours to change' is a grey micro-label with no affordance; the Risk color row (Violet/Red/Orange) is the most protocol-relevant control here and is styled as a cosmetic preference.
fixes: Clamp preview bars to the card's inner width with a fade/overflow marker (the copy already describes the fade — implement it in the demo).
Gate 'Reveal recovery phrase' behind re-authentication and a red caution banner; move it below a divider labelled 'Danger zone' together with 'Forget vault'.
Add a consequence line per toggle: 'Accounts off hides hub lanes, credit and dispute actions from Home and Desk.'
Promote Risk color above Material/Accent and describe it as a semantic control, since it changes the meaning of the whole palette.

top_issues: The TO·Account card shows '130.00 USD' — the destination's current balance, not the post-move result — in the identical format to the FROM balance, so the user cannot tell source from target at a glance.
'USD' abbreviation appears only here ('40.00 USD', '130.00 USD') while the rest of the product writes 'USDC'.
No fee or gas line: Reserve→Account 'posts collateral on-chain', which costs gas, but the WHAT HAPPENS panel never mentions it.
Wallet is selectable as FROM at '0.00 USD' with no disabled state or 'insufficient' reason; the error will only surface after Sign & send.
'Add to batch' is an unexplained secondary action with no batch view or counter anywhere in the set.
fixes: Show projected results: FROM '40.00 → 15.00', TO '130.00 → 155.00' in the selected cards.
Use full tickers everywhere ('USDC').
Add a 'Cost: ~$0.02 gas · lands in ~4 s' row above the CTA for any path that touches chain.
Disable a zero-balance source card with an inline 'No balance' reason.
Give 'Add to batch' a badge with the batch count and a route to the batch screen.

top_issues: Roughly 60% of the canvas is empty below 'NEEDS ATTENTION'; five tiles and two cards float in the top-left, so the screen reads unfinished at 1440px.

'WHERE YOUR MONEY STANDS' repeats the Home legend in different words ('Yours whatever a hub does' vs 'On-chain + Reserve + Secured'), and the numbers ($197.99 / $100.00 / $97.99) do not visibly decompose — the reader must add three tiers themselves.
The 'Accounts' card on the right is the only path into the hub lane but is styled as a sidebar afterthought, weaker than the 'Ownership' tile.
'Nothing waiting on you' is a good empty state but there is no example of what the populated state looks like, so a user cannot learn what 'waiting' means.
Tile subtitles ('Board, shares, takeovers', 'On-chain wallet, faucets, debts') are comma lists, not descriptions of the action.
fixes: Reflow to a two-column layout that fills the viewport: money-stands panel full width with a stacked bar matching Home, accounts list beneath.
Add a decomposition bar to 'WHERE YOUR MONEY STANDS' using the same scale rule as Home, so $100.00 + $97.99 is visibly $197.99.
Promote Accounts to a primary row with per-account exposure and a 'Cover it' action when uncovered > 0.
Rewrite subtitles as verbs: 'Issue shares or change owners', 'Claim test money, move it into reserve'.

top_issues: 'Depository may pull 0.00' under every token is unexplained protocol jargon on a balance line; it reads like a fee or an allowance and is the only mention of the concept in the set.

The right column mixes a test faucet with a production credit-extension flow ('Permanent limit you grant H1: 115.499973 USDC → 175.451049 USDC') — a user asking for 100 test USDC is asked to grant a 60 USDC unsecured credit increase with 8-decimal precision.
'Receive USDC from H1' is disabled with no reason; three further buttons below it are enabled, so the primary path is the only broken one.
New credit shown as '59.951076 USDC' for a requested 100 — the 40.049% haircut (collateral/fee) is never stated.
Left column ends after DEBTS with ~700px of empty canvas.
fixes: Replace 'Depository may pull 0.00' with 'Reserve claimable: 0.00' or hide it when zero.
Split the panel: 'Test faucets' (compact, one button, no credit maths) and a separate 'Incoming capacity' screen for credit grants.
Show the reason on the disabled CTA: 'Blocked: H1 requires 40.05 collateral or a credit limit increase'.
Round granted credit to 2dp and show the deduction line: '100.00 requested − 40.05 collateral − 0.00 fee = 59.95 new credit'.

top_issues: Omar's question — what a hub earns and what the lender earns — is unanswerable: H1 POOL shows Available 0.00, Borrowed 0.00, Active principal 0.00 with no APY, no historical utilisation, no fee split and no default history.
'Interest you ask · basis points 100 = 1.00% per term' asks a retail user to price risk in bps with no market reference and no guidance band.
The 'Borrow' tab is present but the screen gives no collateral requirement, liquidation rule or term cost — a lending product with one of its two directions undocumented.
'Offer to the pool' is disabled with no reason; the only explanation is a sentence below the button.
Term chips (1 hour / 1 day / 1 month) are fixed; there is no indication whether the hub accepts, and no queue/offer status screen exists in the set.
fixes: Add a pool header: '7-day utilisation 62% · median rate 180 bps · defaults 0' so the user can price against something.
Replace the raw bps field with a rate slider plus a 'market median' marker and a plain-English readout ('about $0.10 per day on $100').
Add a Borrow tab content: collateral required, LTV, liquidation threshold, total repayment.
State the disabled reason on the CTA ('Enter an amount above the 1.00 USDC minimum').

top_issues: The copy explains that a board can grow to 2-of-3 or 3-of-5 and that changes are on-chain rotations, but there is no 'Add signer' or 'Change threshold' control on the screen — the described capability is unreachable.
About 70% of the canvas is empty; the right panel is a single sentence of negative state.
'Self-issued (its id is the hash of its board)' is a protocol fact presented as a value with no consequence explained (why the user should care).
No backup/recovery guidance despite the page being the authority on key custody; 'lost key never means a lost entity' is asserted but the recovery path is not shown.
Signer hash is truncated with no copy or verify action.
fixes: Add 'Add signer', 'Raise threshold' and 'Rotate board' actions with a preview of the on-chain rotation.
Add a 'Recovery' card: current backup status, what happens if the device is lost, link to the evidence bundle.
Give the Entity id and Signer full-length copy buttons.
Use the empty right column for a board diagram (1 of 1 → 2 of 3) so the concept is visual, not prose.

top_issues: The 'PER COUNTERPARTY' card's body text is rendered on top of itself: 'co-signed · proof on file: you can dispu' collides with '$60.00 they answer in 1 d · you in 1 d · open → Manage → Dispu' — the single most important exposure summary is unreadable and clipped at the card edge.

'Enforceable right now $100.00' decomposes into On-chain 0 + Reserve 40 + Collateral 60, but 'Collateral behind what you are owed $60.00' is a different kind of number from the other two (it is not a balance the user holds), so the sum is arithmetically right and conceptually wrong.

'Accounts co-signed 1 of 1' and 'Can dispute without asking 1 of 1' are green 'good' values but the fraction format is ambiguous — 1 of 1 could mean one account out of one, or one signature of one required.
The 'Save evidence bundle' button is de-emphasised (dark, low contrast) for what Elena would call the most valuable control in the product.
Long prose block under the legend at small size repeats the two-colours rule for a third time.
fixes: Fix the overlap: give the counterparty card a two-row layout ('$97.99 at risk' / 'co-signed · proof on file · you can dispute · H1 answers in 1 d') with overflow-wrap and a max-width test.
Split the legend into 'You hold: $40.00 (on-chain 0, reserve 40)' and 'Backed by collateral: $60.00' so enforceable is shown as two different kinds of claim.
Rewrite as '1 of your 1 accounts is co-signed' and 'you can dispute all of them without asking'.
Make 'Save evidence bundle' a primary button and add 'Export all proofs (JSON/CSV)'.

top_issues: Column header 'CREDIT OUT·I' is clipped mid-word — the table's right edge is cut off by the panel width.

Totals do not reconcile: the Reserve·on-chain row shows Secured $60.00 and Promised $97.99, but the three H1 lanes sum to 60.00 secured and 70.01 promised; the reader cannot tell whether the reserve row is a total or another lane.
The 'YOU OWE' column shows an orange '$0.00' for the reserve row and em-dashes elsewhere, so zero is represented three ways (—, 0.00, $0.00) in one table.
Four KPI cards, a table, a legend and a book occupy the top 55% of a 1600px canvas; the lower 45% is empty — the 'dense console' promise is only half-implemented.
Numbers are right-aligned but mixed units (USDC, WETH, USD) sit in the same columns with no per-row currency, so '+0.01' and '+130.00' are not comparable.
The book ladder has no depth axis or click affordance beyond a caption at the bottom.
fixes: Widen the table or shorten the header to 'CREDIT OUT·IN'; add a horizontal-scroll shadow rather than clipping.
Separate the aggregate row visually (top border + 'TOTAL' label) and make its figures equal the lane sums.
Pick one zero representation (em-dash) and one currency column, or append the ticker to every value.
Fill the lower canvas with the recent-activity rail and open orders, which currently only exist on Home.

top_issues: The scrim does not fully occlude the desk: the book ladder's price column bleeds through the right edge of the palette and competes with the item list for fixation.
'Manage — batch, attention, doors' uses 'doors', a term defined nowhere in the product's visible vocabulary.
Only 10 of the ~15 destinations are listed with no scroll indicator or grouping (money / accounts / admin), so the user cannot tell whether the list is complete.
No recent-destination or account shortcuts; the palette is a static sitemap, which undercuts its speed value.
The ⌘K hint appears only in the trigger and the placeholder; no visible keyboard-focus ring is demonstrated.
fixes: Raise scrim opacity to ≥75% and blur the background so the palette is the only readable layer.
Replace 'doors' with the plain-language destination name.
Group items under 'Money', 'Accounts', 'Admin' and show a scroll cue plus the total count.
Add a 'Recent' section pinned above the list and support typing an account name (H1) to jump to its lane.

overall.verdict: This is a genuinely differentiated wallet: the green-is-yours / violet-is-a-promise model, the before/after account panel on Pay, the per-frame proof on every receipt and the Sovereignty exposure view give it a trust story no mainstream wallet has, and a power user can operate the whole product from Desk plus the palette. It is not shippable at this bar: three screens have literal text-collision or contrast failures (06b-dispute, 15-sovereignty, 09-settings scale demo), number formatting and totals disagree across screens (5 vs 7 movements, 60,00 vs 115.50, unreconciled Desk columns), and the two hardest jobs — placing a limit order and doing a cross-chain transfer with a known cost and ETA — are explained in grey prose instead of controls.
priority_fixes: Eliminate the rendering defects that break the trust story: fix the overlapping text in 06b-dispute and the PER COUNTERPARTY card in 15-sovereignty, raise dispute modal contrast to ≥7:1 with a full scrim, and clamp the AT THIS SCALE bars inside their card.

Impose one number contract app-wide (dot decimals, 2dp for money, fixed 4dp for prices, full ticker names, one zero glyph) and add a build-time check; then reconcile every aggregate (activity header vs rows, Desk reserve row vs lane sums, Home legend vs Manage breakdown).
Make Pay usable by non-technical people: a contacts/address-book picker with resolved names and a new-counterparty confirmation, so a send never requires pasting a 64-character entity id.

Turn Swap into a real trading surface: explicit Market/Limit segmented control, editable limit price, tap-a-level-to-fill, a single reconciled amount across quote and legs, and a 'total cost + lands in ~Ns' summary strip for cross-network routes.

Deliver the audit path Elena actually needs: an export dialog with date range, per-counterparty filter, both signers and frame hashes per row, plus a prominent 'Save evidence bundle' — and regenerate the whole screenshot corpus from one WAL so timestamps and frame numbers agree.

personas.name: Rosa
personas.verdict: I can see my money and I can see it is safe-ish, but you are asking me to type my grandson's long number and to trust a purple bar I cannot read without my glasses.
blockers: 02-pay: the 'To' field takes a 64-character hex id and there is no contacts screen in the set
01-home: the four-tier legend and stacked bar are colour-led at small text size
06b-dispute: the rules of the one irreversible action are unreadable grey-on-black

personas.name: Jamal
personas.verdict: Money lands instantly and 'Spendable now' tells me exactly what I can touch, so the day is fine — it is Friday night, when I move the week somewhere safe, that I have to learn three storage tiers.
blockers: 10-move: FROM and TO cards both show current balances, so the result of the move is not visible
10-move: no fee/gas line even though Reserve→Account goes on-chain
07-activity: duplicate-looking rows make it hard to confirm a payment arrived once, not twice

personas.name: Priya
personas.verdict: I can put a code on the counter, but I cannot run a till on it — nothing tells me what happens if a customer pays more than my 45.50 capacity, and closing time means counting rows myself.
blockers: 04-receive: '45.50 capacity via H1' has no stated consequence for an over-capacity payment
04-receive: no large counter-display mode; the QR is fixed size
07-activity: no per-counterparty or settled-only reconciliation view and no date-range export

personas.name: Wei
personas.verdict: The book is live and the ladder is clean, but I have to read a sentence of grey copy to discover that typing an amount makes it a limit order, and I still cannot see my fills or my total hub exposure from one place.
blockers: 05-swap: no Market/Limit control; limit order is implied by body text only
05-swap: 'Hub fee 1 bps · up to 0.0000 WETH' is a meaningless display
06-account: exposure is per-lane, with no aggregated counterparty limit/utilisation view
16-desk: 'CREDIT OUT·I' column is clipped and the totals do not sum to the lanes

personas.name: Elena
personas.verdict: Frame numbers, proof hashes and '2 committed entries' are the right bones and the evidence bundle is genuinely good, but I cannot reconcile a ledger whose header says 5 movements while the list says 7, and the proofs are not bulk-exportable.
blockers: 07-activity: header count (5) contradicts list and badge (7)
07-activity: 'Export CSV' has no date range, no per-counterparty filter, no proof column
08-activity-detail: '2 committed entries' is not expandable to the two frames and both signers
06b-dispute: no preview of which signed frame is submitted on-chain

personas.name: Noah
personas.verdict: This is the first wallet UI that does not lie about the protocol — frames, lanes, secured versus promised, dense Desk console and the Sovereignty ledger map cleanly onto accounts, credit, collateral and disputes, and the palette teaches me the whole object model in ten seconds.
blockers: 12-assets: 'Depository may pull 0.00' introduces the Depository's authority in a footnote instead of the model
05b-swap-cross: leg amounts (0.01) and delivered amount (0.007998) are not reconciled, which misleads about lot rounding
14-ownership: describes board rotation but exposes no control, so the model looks richer than the API

personas.name: Aisha
personas.verdict: I can see the two legs, which is more than most bridges tell me, but I cannot tell my finance officer what the transfer costs in total or when payroll lands, and the one panel that explains the risk is sitting on top of the control I need to use.
blockers: 05b-swap-cross: no total fee (H1 + H3 + both legs' gas) and no arrival estimate
05b-swap-cross: tooltip overlaps the collateral slider, blocking the capacity step
05b-swap-cross: the cross-network path shown is USDC→WETH; there is no USDT→USDT stable-to-stable route in the set
weak-connection: no queued/offline state anywhere in the corpus

personas.name: Lucas
personas.verdict: Getting the ten bucks is easy, but the second I try to buy ETH I am being asked about collateral, credit limits and a permanent limit I grant to H1, and the button is purple and won't press.
blockers: 05-swap: 'Prepare to receive' + 'Extend credit limit' + 'Add 10% buffer' sits between him and a $10 ETH buy
